resolved_findings.finding: Earlier width predicate accepted scalar memory in a widened chunk body. Owner now declines any body sload/sstore and any additional carried scalar state; source-prologue/epilogue ABI reads/stats stores remain unchanged.

Width now binds real TIR pointer roots to native views; unknown/pointer-table/structured/volatile forms decline. Native guard compares 64-bit backing-storage base pointers at offsetof(view.storage)=48 in 56-byte records. It checks read/write and write/write pairs. Equal backing storage retains 32 active lanes and 32-step traversal; distinct storage may select wider geometry. view.data inequality is never used as a disjointness proof.
The SDK lock digest now participates in both complete-program identity and runtime-object stamps; source dependency discovery covers factory, passes, planning and native headers.

Old owner collector tools symlink could change run_scan ROOT. Those records are kept with a provenance caveat; owner recollected with hard-copied tools. This reviewer’s baseline/current/final collectors directly import the production factory from explicit frozen root, and final profiles assert/hash every actual imported a100c/support module. Full-scan launcher likewise asserts the actual copied runner/import roots.

width_legality.structural_guards: One simple lane-independent function; fixed 32-lane source regions; divisible static BLOCK; exact induction and work-counter updates. Cross-lane reductions, shuffle/gather/scan/IME, scalar math services, atomics/ordering, narrow fallback and dynamic initial AVL decline.
width_legality.pressure: Public read-only query reuses allocator CFG liveness. Inputs and results are counted together; vector cost is max(explicit LMUL,indexed EEW/SEW implied EMUL); masks including fixed v0 cost a register. Candidate caps 28 vector registers and GPR <= max(25,baseline). Verifier and real allocation remain authoritative; no coloring success is inferred merely from the estimate.
width_legality.state: Every data LMUL and vset region is widened consistently; native selected AVL drives both chunk traversal and work increments. Alias fallback keeps original active lane count under wider physical groups; no cross-lane operation observes unused lanes.
width_legality.runtime_shape: Only static BLOCK/CFG/pressure select candidates. Actual N remains runtime-symbolic; the same artifact is tested for small/large/small N and alias/nonalias bindings.

narrow_legality.addresses: Check each active lane’s actual i64 byte offset against the 16-lane contiguous segment expectation, after the existing address materializer. Guard performs arithmetic only, no source/destination access.
narrow_legality.masks: First-inactive and fully inactive poisoned addresses do not dereference source memory; masked unit loads explicitly restore typed defaults. Type-mismatched vector other and volatile accesses decline.
narrow_legality.fallback: Guard mismatch executes the original scalar lowering with original masking/default behavior; segment stores preserve segment order and only accept distinct consecutive active addresses within each segment.
narrow_legality.resource_bounds: Only data SEW8/16, LMUL1, VL16/32; guard scratch fits the already allocated narrow workspace, and the join restores region state. Guarded narrow CFG is ineligible for automatic width, so the two mechanisms are not force-composed on the same loop.
